1000 Bornes - Coups-Fourres et Courses F.name: 1000 Bornes: Coups-Fourres et Courses Folles!
1000 Bornes - Coups-Fourres et Courses F.summary: Discover the famous card game 1000 Bornes on DS updated with some new features. The title features a "classic" mode with the same rules as the original but also a "special" mode with delightful mini-games to counter your opponent's attacks using the stylus and microphone. A single cartridge holds up to six players.

Internado, El - Laguna Negra.name: El Internado Laguna Negra
Internado, El - Laguna Negra.summary:
The video game follows the structure of the television series, but it is full of extra content, parallel plots and new scripts supervised by the series' writers, so that the end of the game will be an unknown even for the most loyal followers of the plot. from El Internado. In this sense, in the game the relationships between the students will have a very important weight in the development of the game's plot, being able to investigate and discover in first person the dark secret that the Laguna Negra boarding school hides.

During the adventure, it is possible to embody five of the protagonists of the series of the player's choice, these being Carol, Ivan, Marcos, Julia and Vicky. With them, the player aims to explore the scenarios seen in the series while looking for clues and interacting with other characters, in addition to having to overcome various minigames and puzzles that will require the use of the special features of the game. portable such as using the touch screen or microphone.

Regarding the graphic section, the game presents a visual style that combines the two and three dimensions on the upper and lower screen of the laptop, showing all the narrative sequences through black and white scenes in a similar way to those seen in movies such as , for example, Sin City.

Magical Michael Pang.name: Pang: Magical Michael
Magical Michael Pang.summary: Michael, an aspiring young magician, has failed an experiment - leading to dire consequences!

Monster Trucks DS.name: Monster Trucks DS
Monster Trucks DS.summary: Nintendo DS racing game from Skyworks Technologies and Majesco. Jump behind the wheel of your favorite monster truck and race on 25 different all-terrain tracks in five different environments. Master eight different monster rides, each with different starting attributes. As you complete challenges, you can upgrade your monster trucks in the performance shops between races with the cash you earn by winning the races. Tear-up the tracks and put it all on the line with your friends via a four-person multiplayer mode.

Scene It Twilight.name: Scene It? Twilight
Scene It Twilight.summary: Scene It? Twilight is an entry in the Scene It? series that focuses strictly on the Twilight universe.

Spider-Man - Web of Shadows.name: Spider-Man: Web of Shadows
Spider-Man - Web of Shadows.summary:
Spider-Man: Web of Shadows gives Spider-Man the powers of both the classic red suit and the newer black suit. As he progresses deeper into the game, players must decide which suit to rely on - the agility and quickness of the red suit, or the sheer power of the black suit. As Spider-Man defeats enemies, he'll unlock new abilities, web moves, and suit upgrades, including the ability to call in other Marvel characters as allies, such as Nightcrawler and Green Goblin.

The game's sidescrolling action lets players explore the expansive, symbiote-corrupted New York at their own pace. Abilities unlocked in the game let players explore deeper into the city, allowing Spider-Man to traverse symbiotic sludge and blast through ichor-filled tunnels, as well as defeat the increasingly-dangerous infected denizens.

SpongeBob vs the Big One - Beach Party C.name: SpongeBob vs. The Big One: Beach Party Cook-Off
SpongeBob vs the Big One - Beach Party C.summary: Play as Spongebob in this DS exclusive cooking simulator and help him become the best chef in bikini bottom

Tongari Boushi to Mahou no Omise.name: Tongari Boushi to Mahou no Omise
Tongari Boushi to Mahou no Omise.summary:
Tongari Boushi to Mahou no Omise is the follow-up of Magician's Quest: Mysterious Times. It retains the Animal Crossing like gameplay of the previous game, however there is now an emphasis on owning and running a shop. These shops cover all types of goods from cakes to flowers to clothes to furniture. The shops products are created by playing mini-games.

The game also has further updates from the previous game. There is now a new castle location where players can hear the king's opinion on their store. The number of students, teachers, spells, incantations, furniture, cd's, insects, and fish have all been increased too.
